subject: Annual prepay invoicing: automation for staged disbursements and country VAT routing
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay + PO attached — request for staged drawdown automation and VAT handling

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to move forward on the annual committed spend for 2025 — attached is our PO (Acme_PO_#4902.pdf). We plan to prepay the agreed amount and want to automate monthly/quarterly drawdowns to match our consumption forecast.

Two asks to confirm:
- Can Redwood accept a single upfront invoice and then execute scheduled drawdowns automatically (CSV/webhook) into our ledger?
- VAT: Acme is EU-registered in Ireland; for services the reverse charge typically applies. We'll attach VAT registration evidence (VAT_Registration_Evidence.zip). Please confirm how Redwood will record VAT for cross-border services and what evidence you need.

I've cc'd procurement for PO routing. We would like your proposed schedule and a sample CSV for your accounting handoff.

Oliver
Procurement Lead, Acme Analytics
procure@acme-analytics.com

Attachments: Acme_PO_#4902.pdf, VAT_Registration_Evidence.zip
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + PO attached — request for staged drawdown automation and VAT handling

Hi Oliver — great to see the PO, thanks. Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Yes: we can invoice the full annual amount up front and schedule automated drawdowns (monthly or custom cadence). We support both outbound webhooks and SFTP/CSV ingest into your ledger.
- VAT handling: Redwood can map the invoice to zero-rated/reverse-charge reporting for EU customers when you provide registration evidence. We will include the VAT reference on our ledger exports and on the invoice for audit.

Proposed plan (for your confirmation):
1) Redwood issues upfront invoice via DocuSign for the full committed amount tied to PO #4902.
2) Upon receipt, finance (Marcus) will set the account to "staged-disbursement" and schedule monthly drawdowns starting 2025-06-01.
3) For automation: we can provide a webhook that posts a JSON payload on each drawdown and a nightly CSV snapshot (sample format attached: sample_drawdown_csv.csv).
4) For VAT: we will mark invoices as reverse charge and include your VAT ID; please confirm the exact entity name on the VAT certificate.

Kimberly — can you confirm the bank remittance and ledger tag we should use for Acme? Marcus, I'll need your go-ahead to set the account to staged-disbursements after receipt.

Oliver — if that plan looks good, we can send the DocuSign invoice and a short technical spec for the webhook/CSV schema.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + PO attached — request for staged drawdown automation and VAT handling

Thanks — looping in bookkeeping ops notes for the setup.

Operational checklist (finance):
- Map PO #4902 to customer Acme Analytics (entity: Acme Analytics Ltd., VAT IE1234567). Confirmed.
- Create ledger account code: RDW-ACME-4902-PREPAY.
- Invoice: full amount on receipt, payment reconciliation against PO.
- Drawdown cadence: monthly on the 1st. We will generate a ledger CSV each night (columns: date, token_units, amount_usd, invoice_ref, vat_flag, vat_id). Attached sample_drawdown_csv.csv shows the format.
- VAT reporting: mark transactions with vat_flag=RC (reverse charge) and include vat_id in export. For EU audit, we'll retain the VAT evidence zip in the deal folder for 7 years.

Bank/remit instructions needed from Acme: preferred payee name, bank account last 4 digits, and whether they require beneficiary verification for pre-authorized debits.

Kimberly, please confirm the DocuSign invoice template includes the reverse charge language we discussed ("VAT reverse charge applies; customer liable for VAT under local law") and the PO field.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay + PO attached — request for staged drawdown automation and VAT handling

Hi Vanessa / Marcus — this all looks good to us.

Confirming:
- Entity on VAT cert: Acme Analytics Ltd. (VAT IE1234567). VAT evidence attached.
- Remit: bank account ending 8124 (EUR-USD clearing OK), beneficiary verification not required for this vendor.
- Drawdown cadence: monthly on the 1st is fine.

Please send the DocuSign invoice when ready and the webhook spec. We'll countercheck the CSV format against our ledger ingestion. Once DocuSign is signed we will push payment and confirm receipt.

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Procurement Lead, Acme Analytics
oliver@acme-analytics.com
